sections.text: Introduction

This document lists the equipment inspection I3, which must be 
 performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block

Type: Lead Acid Battery 
 Maintenance Free
No. of Cells: 108
Cell Voltage: 2V
Capacity: 250 Ah

The first 
 draft initiated by eng. Abdallah Elsayed M, revised by quality control eng. 
 Adel Abdel Qader El nagar at EDEPC, accepted by eng El Sayed Attiah, 
 and approved by eng. Awad Soliman Head Sector of Talkha PS.

Safety 
Precautions

A work 
 permit must be issued and maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety 
 category,

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required,

Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as 
 safety shoes, safety Helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses, safety goggles, rubber gloves and rubber 
 apron.

The door of the battery room must be provided with 
 sign of No Smoking.

The battery instructions must be 
 displayed visibly on the wall..

Water source must be available in 
 the battery room.

When working in the battery room 
 be aware of parts under voltage.

The battery set is out 
 of service if necessary.

items:
The battery set is out 
 of service if necessary.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

Thermometer, 
 and 
 Hydrometer

Digital 
 multimeter ( AVO METER )
Work to be Carried Out
Perform the monthly maintenance procedure.

Measure and record the specific gravity in each cell. The accepted 
 limit is ( 1.24 0.02 ).
Cheek and record the temperature of the electrolyte in each cell.
Disconnect AC supply to battery charger.

Read and record over all battery immediately after AC power is 
 switched off and then after 15 Minutes.
Record the voltage every hour for 8 hour duration.

If voltage fall below 215v, stop the test and charge the 
 battery set in boost mode for 5 hours .

Return to the floating mode and compare the obtained readings with 
 the readings recorded in previous years.
Place the battery set back into normal operating condition.

Measure and record the voltage and density for each cell in the 
 Maintenance Record Data Sheet MRDS
